QuestInfo.name: Thunder Breaker Knighthood Exam
QuestInfo.0: According to #p1101002#, you can take the Knighthood Exam from Chief Knight of Lightning #b#p1101007##k. Go to Ereve and meet #p1101007#.
QuestInfo.1: The Knighthood Exam has begun. It's quite simple. Go to #bThe 2nd Drill Hall#k at the end of the Training Forest, and defeat the monster in it.\r\n#b(If you fail, forfeit the quest and start it again.)
QuestInfo.2: You have completed the Knighthood Exam. You are no longer a Knight-in-Training, but a full-fledged official knight. May your raucous adventures serve the Cygnus Knights in some way.

default.0: Have you taken your Trial at the #bSecond Drill Hall#k at the end of the Training Forest? Please hurry and do that.

0.0: Ahoy, there! I deem yer ready to take yer Knighthood Exam! If it's all right with ye, how about we start right away?
0.1: All ye have to do is head to the #Second Drill Hall#k at the end of the Training Forest and defeat 30 Tiguru of Exam monsters. Then let #p1101007# know.
0.2: Everyone'll accept ye as a knight once you pass the exam. Yer bringin' tears of pride to this ol' captain's eyes!\r\n#e#b(If you accept, you'll travel to #m130020000# automatically.)#k#n

no.0: If yer busy, I'll wait. Take yer time, and let me know when yer ready.
